newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Petronas expects Vietnam Ruby, Emerald oil in '98.
newsitem.headline: Petronas expects Vietnam Ruby, Emerald oil in '98.

text.p: Malaysia national oil firm Petronas's said on Tuesday it expected first production from its Ruby and Emerald crude fields in Vietnam in the third quarter of 1998.
"First oil is expected to flow in the third quarter of 1998," Petronas president and chief executive Hassan Marican told Reuters on the sidelines of an oil and gas conference.
Petronas initially scheduled first production from the fields in 1997, but the date has gradually been put back to 1998.
The Ruby field has estimated reserves of 200 million barrels and is located next to the Dai Hung oil field.
In December, Petronas said Ruby would produce 9,500 barrels per day by the end of 1997 and 85,000 bpd by 2003.
Elsewhere, Marican said its joint venture company in Sudan with Chinese National Petroleum Corp (CNPC) was expected to see first oil flows at the end of 1999.
The oil field was estimated to have proven reserves of around 600 million barrels.
